title: Oil Pump
ocr_text:
AT-52     AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSION — Component Groups (Oil Pump)

Oil Pump

Pump Body
◆O-Ring
Drive Gear
Pump Cover
◆Oil Seal
Driven Gear
Oil Seal Ring
◆ Non-reusable part

DISASSEMBLY OF OIL PUMP

1. USE TORQUE CONVERTER AS A WORK STAND

2. REMOVE TWO OIL SEAL RINGS FROM PUMP COVER

3. REMOVE PUMP COVER

4. REMOVE O-RING FROM PUMP

5. LIFT PUMP OFF CONVERTER AND REMOVE OIL PUMP DRIVE GEAR AND DRIVEN GEAR
Identify the top and bottom and keep in assembly order.
